📻 VAICOM — what every switch does

Open the real window with LCtrl + LAlt + C while VoiceAttack is running. This page is the same window, but you can hover anything to learn what it does — green ✅ tags show what the CobbAttack setup expects. Which boxes to tick is in the Setup Instruction, step 4; this page is the why.

The radio panel: shows which TX button talks on which radio for the aircraft you're flying. You mostly just LOOK at this page — the actual TX buttons are bound in VoiceAttack.

Sound redirection: send VAICOM's own sounds (squelch, AOCS voice, chatter) to a specific speaker/headset. Our setup leaves it OFF — DCS's own audio settings handle device routing now.
